name: Leaf Venation
desc: Space-colonization vein networks branch toward scattered auxin sources and thicken into a glowing leaf-coral-river tree that fills the frame then reseeds, rendered as gold hyphae on teal-black, botanical green veins, a cyanotype blueprint, crimson nerve dendrites, or sumi ink-roots.

density.doc: auxin sources (70..400) + node cap (350..1600) -> how densely the veins fill the frame

energy.doc: vein brightness/glow + sap-pulse & wobble amplitude + audio gain

scale.doc: overall size of the growing figure

taper.doc: Murray thickness law: 0 = uniform filament, 1 = fat trunk + hairline tips

spread.doc: influence radius (0.09u..0.22u): low = bushy/dense, high = long reaching veins

hue.doc: filament hue (hyphae gold / nerve crimson); accent for the fixed-palette styles

style.doc: render philosophy: hyphae = luminous gold filaments on deep teal-black (Nervous System) / leaf = botanical amber-to-green veins on cream / cyanotype = hairline white contour + node ticks on blueprint blue (abstract schematic) / nerve = crimson dendrites w/ branch swells on near-black, eerie / ink = tapering dry-brush sumi roots on rice-paper, near-monochrome

act.doc: grow = steady growth, hold, reseed a fresh figure each cycle / breathe = growth rate swells with section intensity / prune = shorter hold -> faster perpetual churn

seed.doc: deterministic auxin scatter + ground texture; each reseed advances it so the tree is never the same twice

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg; lower = translucent field over layers below)
